scientific_question: Can observation support O be estimated from primary-stream measurement properties without access to biological-event truth, target-observer output, nuisance-observer output, or nuisance truth?

semantic_role.N: exogenous process that may mimic, mask or corrupt target inference
semantic_role.C: target-coupled local response caused by the focal interaction
semantic_role.O: measurement support: whether a focal visit opportunity was observable in the primary stream

hard_independence_rules: O is not defined as 1 minus nuisance burden
the O estimator may not consume PolliPi/target evidence
the O estimator may not consume InsePi/nuisance risk
the O estimator may not consume biological-event truth
the O estimator may not consume exogenous nuisance labels
support truth may be used only for development calibration and held-out scoring, never as estimator input

primary_stream_measurements.name: target_zone_coverage
primary_stream_measurements.meaning: fraction/quality of the focal interaction zone retained inside the usable field of view

primary_stream_measurements.name: target_zone_visibility
primary_stream_measurements.meaning: primary-stream evidence that the relevant target zone is physically visible rather than hidden

primary_stream_measurements.name: spatial_resolution
primary_stream_measurements.meaning: ability of the primary stream to resolve actor/contact scale required by the visit definition

primary_stream_measurements.name: photometric_sufficiency
primary_stream_measurements.meaning: usable exposure/contrast without information-destroying darkness, clipping or saturation

primary_stream_measurements.name: temporal_continuity
primary_stream_measurements.meaning: availability of enough of the relevant interval to observe the defined event rather than frame/dropout gaps

reference_estimator.support_ceiling: minimum of the five normalised component measurements
reference_estimator.warning: thresholds are transparent development defaults, not field-calibrated detection probabilities

truth_contract.source: PrimaryStreamSupportTruth annotated/measured independently of algorithm outputs
truth_contract.unresolved_rule: unresolved support truth is excluded from support-accuracy denominators and reported separately
truth_contract.cause_rule: overall unobservability must not be back-filled into an invented nuisance cause or failed support component

development_then_validation.development: calibrate component measurement procedures and support thresholds using development days/scenes only
development_then_validation.held_out: new recording days and focal scenes/flowers; no threshold or measurement-rule changes after support-estimator output inspection
